target_customer: Electronics engineers and buyers comparing component pricing, availability and specifications
problem: Finding electronic component data across distributors was slow and spread over spreadsheets and poor sites. Octopart indexed pricing, stock and specs for millions of parts.
business_model: search engine monetized by distributor leads and advertising, later data products

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and normalizing millions of parts with live pricing and stock from many distributors needed data engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Distributor relationships and a large normalized parts database built over years were hard to copy quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Distributors became partners rather than rivals; Altium bought Octopart in August 2015 as a wholly owned subsidiary.

market_need_then: The company's own description says engineers lost time to poorly designed supplier sites and haphazard spreadsheets of component data.

identity.logo: not described by any source found

branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch ran a 2011 piece titled The Little Startup That Hung In There; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Became a known name among engineers and later claimed 20 million users per its own site, a self-reported figure.

outcome_analysis: Octopart entered YC in Winter 2007, raised only about 360 thousand dollars of angel seed by May 2008 according to an aggregator, and grew slowly as a niche search engine for engineers. Altium announced the acquisition on August 14, 2015 and it became a subsidiary, with no price disclosed, which suggests a modest but real exit for a capital efficient company.
notes: Company site octopart.com returned HTTP 403 on fetch. Seed amount 360K from one aggregator (Startupintros) and unverified; other aggregators give 100K to 375K. No dated 2007 competitor sources found; FindChips founded 2008 per one directory is not used. Founder education and employers not found. YC page location New York City versus another source's La Jolla.
